shop.tagline: Discover our premium genuine fur, leather, and handcrafted collection.
shop.announcement: Our workshop produces genuine fur pillows, luxury fur blankets, natural fur rugs, bench covers, medical sheepskins, merino sheepskins, and high-quality natural hides. We also supply genuine fur and leather materials for fashion design studios, costume designers, craft projects, film and television productions, and custom creative applications. Our premium natural furs are widely used in fashion design ateliers, costume making, interior decoration projects, and artistic productions, offering exceptional quality, natural beauty, softness, and durability. Each piece is carefully handcrafted in our workshop to bring warmth, comfort, and timeless elegance to both living spaces and creative projects.
